# U025 — Reader API reports wrong primary length unit on multi-context files

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.5 (`12-5-units`)  
**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-5-units/U025.stp`](../../step-examples/12-5-units/U025.stp)  

## Sources
- 03-occt-tests.md R054 (bug23567 — `stepfileunits` returned wrong primary unit)

## Description

The reader API entry point that returns the file's length unit reports a unit different from the one the receiver actually applied to coordinates during transfer. Downstream tools that read the reported unit and apply scaling produce wrong geometry — coordinates end up scaled inconsistently with the unit label.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP with multiple `length_unit` records or with a `LENGTH_UNIT_AND_GLOBAL_UNIT_ASSIGNED_CONTEXT` complex; the file-units query returns an unrelated nested unit.

## Expected kernel behavior

the file-units query must walk the active context tree and return the unit actually applied to coordinates, not an arbitrary nested unit definition.
